bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value)" != active
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value)" != active
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,tempfile
p=Path("scripts/userbot_test_client.py")
s=p.read_text()
before='        elif action == "list_channel_videos":'
after=('        elif action == "list_channel_video_page":\n'
       '            if channel_id is None or chat_id is not None or message_id is not None or limit is not None:\n'
       '                raise ValueError("VIDEO_PAGE_TARGET_REQUIRED")\n'
       '            request["channel_id"] = channel_id\n'
       +before)
if s.count(before)!=1 or 'elif action == "list_channel_video_page":' in s:
 raise RuntimeError("LIVE_RESIDENT_CLIENT_PAGE_PATCH_CONFLICT")
s=s.replace(before,after,1)
compile(s,str(p),"exec")
fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".video-page-client-",dir=str(p.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as out:out.write(s)
 os.chmod(temp,0o644)
 os.replace(temp,p)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(temp):os.unlink(temp)
print("PAGINATED_CLIENT_ROUTE=PATCHED")
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
from userbot_test_client import invoke
async def check():
 r=await invoke("list_channel_video_page",channel_id=1877875443)
 print("PAGINATION_LIVE_STATUS="+str(r.get("status")))
 print("PAGINATION_LIVE_SCANNED="+str(r.get("scanned")))
 if r.get("status")!="PASS" or type(r.get("videos")) is not list:raise RuntimeError("LIVE_PAGINATION_NOT_READY")
asyncio.run(check())
PY
